The paper states that SDDPM "can recover images even in case of extremely high noise conditions" etc. So A seems correct.

B. "The denoising ability of the baseline convolution structure decreases exponentially with the increase of noise". They don't have explicit mention of exponential decrease. They said "the performance of DnCNN, SCU, SwinIR and SDDPM for low noise vs high noise" but did not mention exponential.
